title: TextToMeshRequest
description: Params in for the whole skill: a sentence describing one object.

seed.description: Omit for a seed derived from the prompt. Fixes the image, which fixes the mesh.

steps.description: FLUX.2 klein is distilled for 4 steps. More does not buy detail: the distilled endpoint ignores the parameter upstream, and pushing it produces a waxy, overcooked image. The ceiling is 8 so a caller can experiment without wrecking a render.

imageSize.description: Square render size. Used when imageWidth and imageHeight are omitted, and ignored when they are given.

imageWidth.description: Render width. Set with imageHeight for a portrait render, which is what a standing figure wants: a square wastes half its pixels on backdrop and the face reaches the reconstructor smaller. Omit for the character default (832x1216) or the square imageSize.

framing.description: Passed to text2image. auto reads the prompt for words that mean a person, and asks for the neutral A-pose a rig needs instead of a three-quarter product shot.

textureResolution.description: PBR volume resolution, passed to image2mesh. Omit for the engine's auto choice, which drops a dense res-1024 decode to 512. Force 1024 when the subject has a face.

atlasPx.description: UV atlas size, passed to image2mesh. Omit for 2048 at res 1024, 1024 at res 512. Larger gives a face more texels.

targetFaces.description: Quadric simplify target in faces, passed straight to image2mesh. Omit for the engine default of 300K at res 1024, 150K at res 512.

outDir.description: Where the PNG and GLB land. Defaults to the working directory.

keepImage.description: false deletes the intermediate PNG once the mesh is out.

enginePath.description: Path to a locally built t2m-cli. Required when runner is binary.
